subject: C03
required_fixes: [P1] RF01 — Do not present content-level scan failures as Allow. crates/desktop-core/src/scanning.rs:233 considers only timeout and the global error flag when determining incompleteness. A schema-valid reply with action=allow, category=benign, timeout=false, error=false and errors=[{content_type:prompt,feature:dlp,status:error}] consequently becomes Verdict::Allow. The pinned SDK schema does not require the global flag to agree with errors. apps/desktop/src/features/runtime/runtime-view.tsx:278 also hides those content errors unless serviceError is true, producing a green Allowed result without the failure details. Classify content-level errors or contradictory completion indicators conservatively and display the relevant partial/error information independently of that global flag. Acceptance: add a literal endpoint response with this combination through production authority/SDK tests and the production React result view; it must never appear Allowed, and the failed content/detector must be visible.

[P2] RF02 — Preserve uncertainty about transmission in operator text. apps/desktop/src/features/runtime/scan-text.ts:108–111 says 'The request was sent' and 'Cancelled after it was sent' for every Unknown outcome. The implementation correctly maps connect failures to Unknown, and DispatchClaimed/cancellation does not prove bytes reached the service. The text therefore asserts evidence the native outcome does not establish. Use wording that permits both sent and not-sent possibilities unless separate positive transmission evidence is available. Acceptance: cover a connection failure before transmission and cancellation after claiming but before transport send; both retain Unknown where appropriate, disclose possible remote execution, avoid asserting successful transmission and never replay automatically.

The C02 receipt binds the earlier tree. Rerun and retain the affected authority/IPC regressions against the repaired C03 fingerprints, as required by chunks/C03.md's earlier-chunk regression instruction.
